message: Thanks for the offer. We can't accept the proposed unit price. Here is our counterproposal: $4.50 per unit, 20 to 100 units, 20% paid at shipment and 80% on receipt, a 10-day lead time with a 1-day grace period, and a late-price cut of 3% per day capped at 15%. Cancel window and deemed-acceptance window stay as you proposed. A person at our company must sign any final agreement.
